description: This file implements the 'EnoughData' class, which is part of a media streaming system. It manages the state indicating whether enough data has been received for audio and video streams, based on the source element.

classes.name: EnoughData
classes.description: A class that checks if enough media data has been received for audio and video streams, and updates the context accordingly.

methods.name: EnoughData::EnoughData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the context and source element, and logs construction.

methods.name: EnoughData::~EnoughData

methods.name: EnoughData::execute
methods.description: Checks the current stream info for audio and video, and updates the context flags to indicate whether more data is needed.
